facts.business: Punjab & Sind Bank is a nationalized public sector bank in India providing banking and financial services including deposits, advances, and investments.

auditor.name: R S KATHURIA & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Board of Directors not duly constituted with required Executive, Non-Executive & Independent Directors as per Section 9 of Banking Companies Act and Regulation 17 of SEBI LODR; positions of directors under Section 9(3)(e), (f), (g) and five under 9(3)(h) vacant; inadequate Independent Directors including woman independent director.

key_risks: Board composition non-compliance with statutory requirements
Vacant director positions under Banking Companies Act
Inadequate independent directors including woman independent director
